diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts correctly identified the initial public facts (52 minutes, 5.1 audio, English subtitles, worldwide availability, 90-second clip) but failed to incorporate the hidden information from PF1 and PF2. Since no checks passed, there is no structural leak; however, the model's failure to pivot decisions suggests the 'decisive' nature of the private facts is not sufficiently forcing a conflict with the public facts in the prompt instructions.
